name: NESS Summer Camp Programs
description_short: Weekly half-day summer programs for ages 4 to 17 at New England Science & Sailing on Stonington Harbor: sailing from first Optimist lessons to 420 and Laser racing, marine science, fishing, surfing and mixed adventure sports. Children can take a morning and an afternoon program with a supervised lunch in between.
swim_waterfront_notes: Programs run on Stonington Harbor and Long Island Sound. Campers don't need to be skilled swimmers but must be comfortable on and around the water. Everyone wears a life jacket on the water; for some activities older campers can take a swim check with a certified lifeguard to go without one.
